Question 3
?

The point (a,b) lies on the curve y=2x. Which of the following points must lie on y=2x−2+3?

a
(a+2,b+3)
b
(a−2,b+3)
c
(a−2,b−3)
d
(a−2,3b)
e
(a+2,b−3)
